02
Cinematic Craft

Video Making

I master two distinct worlds of video creation — and I combine them. Real camera filmmaking: cinematic shooting, professional lighting, on-location direction, and full post-production editing. AI video generation: producing synthetic footage with Sora, Runway, and Kling — from concept to final render. My unique edge is the ability to blend both seamlessly — mixing real footage with AI-generated sequences to create hybrid cinematic content that no standard videographer can deliver. Including an AI-generated film for the prestigious 1 Billion Summit.
